context.title: Chinatown Community Development Center: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Contributions to the Housing Fund)

positions.statement: Malcom Yeung (CEO, Chinatown Community) signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition C in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition H (Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations)

positions.statement: Chinatown Community Development Center signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition H in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
